options.content:
# GPS Fleet Command Center
Live operational view of latest vehicle positions, moving/stopped status, overspeeding vehicles and stale GPS updates. Use the variables above to adjust speed and freshness thresholds.

panels.description: Unique devices reporting within the selected time window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,
    COALESCE(vehicle_type, 'Unknown') AS vehicle_type,
    updated_at
  FROM device_latest_position
  WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, updated_at DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicles FROM latest;

panels.title: Total Vehicles

panels.description: Vehicles moving within the configured speed limit.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,
    COALESCE(vehicle_type, 'Unknown') AS vehicle_type,
    updated_at
  FROM device_latest_position
  WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, updated_at DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS moving FROM latest WHERE device_speed > 0 AND device_speed <= ${speed_limit:raw};

panels.description: Vehicles whose latest GPS update is older than the freshness threshold.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stale_gps FROM latest WHERE updated_at < NOW() - (${stale_minutes:raw} || ' minutes')::interval;

panels.title: Live Vehicle Status Map

panels.description: Shows where the latest GPS points are concentrated.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,
    COALESCE(vehicle_type, 'Unknown') AS vehicle_type,
    updated_at
  FROM device_latest_position
  WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, updated_at DESC
)

SELECT device_id, latitude, longitude, device_speed, vehicle_type, updated_at
FROM latest;

panels.title: Vehicle Density Heatmap

panels.description: Count of latest vehicles by operational status.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,
    COALESCE(vehicle_type, 'Unknown') AS vehicle_type,
    updated_at
  FROM device_latest_position
  WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, updated_at DESC
)

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN device_speed > ${speed_limit:raw} THEN 'Overspeed'
    WHEN device_speed <= 0 THEN 'Stopped'
    ELSE 'Moving'
  END AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS vehicles
FROM latest
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Vehicle Status Distribution

panels.description: Priority list of fastest vehicles above the configured speed limit.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,
    COALESCE(vehicle_type, 'Unknown') AS vehicle_type,
    updated_at
  FROM device_latest_position
  WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, updated_at DESC
)

SELECT
  device_id,
  vehicle_type,
  ROUND(device_speed::numeric, 1) AS speed_kmph,
  orientation,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - updated_at)) / 60)::numeric, 0) AS age_minutes,
  updated_at
FROM latest
WHERE device_speed > ${speed_limit:raw}
ORDER BY device_speed DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Top Overspeed Vehicles

panels.description: Vehicle count by type for the selected time window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id)
    device_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    COALESCE(device_speed, 0) AS device_speed,
    orientation,
    COALESCE(vehicle_type, 'Unknown') AS vehicle_type,
    updated_at
  FROM device_latest_position
  WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY device_id, updated_at DESC
)

SELECT vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS vehicles
FROM latest
GROUP BY vehicle_type
ORDER BY vehicles DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Stale / Not Reporting Vehicles

targets.rawSql: SELECT score_30day_avg FROM device_behaviour_profile WHERE score_30day_avg IS NOT NULL;
SELECT risk_category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM device_behaviour_profile GROUP BY risk_category ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT score_date AS time, SUM(total_hb) AS "Harsh Braking", SUM(total_ha) AS "Harsh Acceleration", SUM(total_rt) AS "Rash Turning" FROM driver_daily_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(score_date) GROUP BY score_date ORDER BY score_date;
SELECT analytics_date AS time, SUM(points_count) AS "Analyzed Points" FROM gps_points_analytics WHERE $__timeFilter(analytics_date) GROUP BY analytics_date ORDER BY analytics_date;
SELECT date AS time, SUM(points_received) AS "Total Points" FROM daily_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
